items.name: LocalTime
items.summary: Formats the current [local time] using a [formatter] from the [`time` crate].

methods.name: new
methods.summary: Returns a formatter that formats the current [local time] using the [`time` crate] with the provided provided format. The format may be any type that implements the [`Formattable`] trait.

methods.name: rfc_3339
methods.summary: Returns a formatter that formats the current [local time] in the [RFC 3339] format (a subset of the [ISO 8601] timestamp format).

items.name: OffsetTime
items.summary: Formats the current time using a fixed offset and a [formatter] from the [`time` crate].

methods.name: local_rfc_3339
methods.summary: Returns a formatter that formats the current time using the [local time offset] in the [RFC 3339] format (a subset of the [ISO 8601] timestamp format).

methods.name: new
methods.signature: fn new(offset: time::UtcOffset, format: F) -> Self
methods.summary: Returns a formatter that formats the current time using the [`time` crate] with the provided provided format and [timezone offset]. The format may be any type that implements the [`Formattable`] trait.

items.name: UtcTime
items.summary: Formats the current [UTC time] using a [formatter] from the [`time` crate].

methods.name: new
methods.summary: Returns a formatter that formats the current [UTC time] using the [`time` crate], with the provided provided format. The format may be any type that implements the [`Formattable`] trait.

methods.name: rfc_3339
methods.summary: Returns a formatter that formats the current [UTC time] in the [RFC 3339] format, which is a subset of the [ISO 8601] timestamp format.
